messages:
Lara (Partnerships): Quick sync: LangChain asked for a limited-run sandbox that wires their orchestrator -> our gateway -> HW partner EdgeNode. We need owners for: marketplace listing, SI playbook, HW validation, deploy automation, and joint comms. Who volunteers?
Owen (Eng-Platform): I can do deploy automation + staging Helm chart. Need sample runner image and endpoint contract.
Alex (LangChain PM): We'll provide runner image (lightweight) and a connector spec. ETA Tue. We'll also include a sample flow YAML.
Sofia (Product): I'll draft the marketplace tile + SKU. Question: should the sandbox be free or gated? Recommend free trial with whitelist.
Cal (SI Lead): SI partners prefer a gated pilot (whitelist) so we can support them during validation. I'll take SI playbook.
Raj (Eng-ML): For HW validation we need quantized perf runs and tokenization parity checks. If EdgeNode will run INT8 models, we need runner images compiled with proper ops.
Marta (Marketing): I'll coordinate comms. We need an embargo window and a short partner blurb. Also can we plan a joint tech webinar after pilot signups?
Lara (Partnerships): Good. Owners: Owen (deploy), Sofia (marketplace), Cal (SI playbook), Raj (HW validation), Marta (comms). Alex supplies assets. I'll track timeline.
Alex (LangChain PM): Uploaded assets: https://drive.example/langchain/sandbox-assets (image, spec, logos). Note: connector supports streaming and function-calls; auth via API key by default.
Owen (Eng-Platform): Got it. I'll add a staging job: make deploy-sandbox, and keep autoscale off for reproducible perf. Also will add endpoint-level feature flags (streaming:true, tools:true).
Raj (Eng-ML): I'll prepare gbench configs: small (32 tokens), med (512), large (4096). Will include expected latency p50/p95. Also will run tokenization parity suite across model variants.
Cal (SI Lead): SI playbook items: preflight checklist, airgap install notes for EdgeNode, debug steps, escalation path. Will include sample infra diagram and runbook for first 3 weeks.
Sofia (Product): Marketplace draft:
```
name: "Redwood + LangChain Orchestrator Sandbox"
sku: RW-LC-ORCH-SBX-2025
short_desc: "Test LangChain orchestrations through Redwood gateway with EdgeNode hardware."
availability: "Private pilot, request access"
```
Will add billing SKU for reserved trial if pilot proceeds.
Marta (Marketing): Proposed comms: internal partner brief, joint invite-only webinar at T+10, public blog at T+21. Need legal signoff by T+7.
Lara (Partnerships): Timeline proposal:
- Day 0 (now): asset upload (Alex)
- Day 2: staging deploy + compat smoke (Owen)
- Day 4: HW perf runs (Raj)
- Day 7: legal/brand signoff (Marta/Nina)
- Day 10: invite-only webinar + SI bootcamp start
- Day 21: public announce
deploy-bot: Preview deploy scheduled: lc-orch-sandbox -> staging at 2025-10-12T20:15Z (id: dp_9203).
Owen (Eng-Platform): After preview I'll run the compat matrix (endpoints, streaming, tool-calls, kv-cache) and post results to https://git.internal/redwood/partnerships/lc-orch-sandbox. Ping me when deploy completes.
Alex (LangChain PM): Heads-up: we have two minor breaking changes planned in the next release; please ensure connector is pinned to compat tag lc-0.35. I will attach compat matrix.
Raj (Eng-ML): Noted. I'll include version gating in perf scripts. Also request SI team allow access to two early pilot customers for edge validation.
Cal (SI Lead): I'll coordinate pilot customer onboarding. Also will request EdgeNode team to reserve 2 devices for validation window (T+4 to T+14).
Marta (Marketing): I'll draft partner email and an internal sales one-pager. Need short quotes from Alex + Redwood PM.
Sofia (Product): I'll open a marketplace PR and attach assets. Will mark listing as private until legal clears.
Lara (Partnerships): Thanks everyone. I'll send a calendar invite for daily standups until T+4 and update the central checklist. :white_check_mark:
